what: Citations in the recorded negotiation moves, with the exact words behind each. resolves: checked by code. review: whether the quote backs the statement the citation is attached to, read by Claude, not by a person.

rows.quote: We ran a one-semester student project with a technical faculty in Novi Sad in 2021 that produced a prototype BACnet fuzzer; the code was useful but the collaboration was not continued formally.
rows.reason: We need a method that works with no attack examples and that we can explain to a plant manager in plain language, and an industrial PhD gives us the three-year runway to embed and field-test it properly. We want company ownership of results so the anomaly detection core can ship in ProtoSense without licensing friction, with the university retaining academic use rights. Our past collaboration produced useful code but ended without formal continuation [C001 past_collaborations], so we want named contact roles and milestone deliverables to keep the work on track.

We want university ownership of results with an option to licence, which is our standard position for joint projects; in return we accept 60-day publication review and narrow the exclusivity to 12 months, matching the project duration. Our researcher has 9 authored publications including work on ICS anomaly detection [R1015 publications], so preserving the right to publish is essential.

rows.quote: Njivomer Agro intends to extend NjivaManager coverage to farms in southern Bačka and the Srem region by the end of 2026, and to offer the water-balance irrigation module as a standard feature of the platform once it is validated.
rows.reason: We need a calculation engine we can own and maintain directly inside NjivaManager, which we intend to offer as a standard platform feature [C022 plans]. A 60-day review period protects our proprietary soil data and know-how contributed to the project, and milestone checkpoints address the absence of prior university collaboration by ensuring tangible deliverables at each stage.

rows.quote: headspace oxygen residual levels above 2% identified as a maximum threshold for small-scale operations
rows.reason: Contract research is the right format for this bounded, answer-focused problem. We want company ownership of results so findings can be applied directly to our process without licensing risk, and we want a 60-day review period to allow removal of any confidential process data before publication. Headspace oxygen residuals above 2% have been identified as a threshold problem for small-scale operations [SYN-PUB-02921], so we need a milestone that confirms the bottling line issue early. Past collaborations have been informal and ended without structured deliverables, so we want a named contact role on both sides and milestone-tied deliverables.

We need results within about ten months to feed into our 2027 module release [C047 plans], so the joint_project format fits this bounded deliverable. We want company ownership of the resulting module to protect our product roadmap, with the university retaining academic use rights; our dataset of ~400 transformers with failure records is a key in-kind contribution.

We want university ownership of results with an option to assign, which gives the company a clear path to full ownership on exercise while protecting the university's position during the PhD. We also want a 30-day review period, which is standard for active publishing groups; 20 authored publications through 2026 mean timely publication is essential [R1008 publications].

We want university ownership with an option for the company to licence results, as joint research generating new knowledge should vest in the university. We accept narrowing exclusivity to the dairy MBR service field and reducing it to 12 months, and in return we reduce publication review to 30 days to support timely academic dissemination given our active publication record [R0745 publications].

rows.quote: access to our traffic archives, our hardware bench, and our existing firmware codebase under NDA
rows.reason: We accept uni_owns_option_to_assign as a workable path to ownership of the anomaly detection core we need for ProtoSense. We want 60-day review because our traffic archives are collected from consenting clients under NDA [C001 rd_capacity], and papers may contain derived features that need careful confidential-data screening before publication.

rows.quote: to offer the water-balance irrigation module as a standard feature of the platform once it is validated
rows.reason: We accept 30-day publication review in exchange for moving to uni_owns_option_to_assign: we intend to offer the water-balance module as a standard platform feature [C022 plans], which requires our developers to own and maintain the engine long-term without ongoing licence dependency. An option to assign gives the university initial ownership while preserving our path to full ownership needed to integrate and maintain the engine inside NjivaManager.
